_snapshotData.name: ON Semiconductor Corporation
_snapshotData.description: ON Semiconductor Corporation provides intelligent sensing and power solutions in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Power Solutions Group, Analog and Mixed-Signal Group, and Intelligent Sensing Group. The Power Solutions Group segment offers discrete, module, and integrated semiconductor devices designed to enable power conversion, including power switching, signal conditioning, and circuit protection technologies. Its Analog and Mixed-Signal Group segment designs and develops analog and mixed-signal solutions, including power management, sensor interface, connectivity, and standard products for automotive, industrial automation, AI data centers, computing, and mobile end markets. The Intelligent Sensing Group segment develops complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor image sensors, image signal processors, short-wave infrared sensors, and other products, as well as photon-counting technologies, including single-photon avalanche diode arrays and silicon photomultiplier devices for depth sensing, factory automation, safety systems, and robotics industries. ON Semiconductor Corporation was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: ON Semiconductor Corporation possesses a narrow economic moat (score: 46/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (moderate) and Learning Curve (weak). ON Semiconductor Corporation shows moderate supply-side economies of scale.

supply_side.explanation: ON Semiconductor Corporation shows moderate supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 11.1% with earnings growing at 26.1% — positive 15.0% operating leverage. solid gross margins of 39.9% and operating margins of 22.2% at at current scale.

network_effects.explanation: ON Semiconductor Corporation has limited demand-side economies of scale. Semiconductors suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: ON Semiconductor Corporation has weak learning curve advantages. In Semiconductors, cumulative R&D creates knowledge barriers new entrants cannot replicate. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: ON Semiconductor Corporation benefits from weak switching costs. Semiconductors creates structural switching costs — established business relationships create meaningful switching friction.  YoY revenue growth of 11.1% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.threat_analysis: AI presents manageable disruption to Semiconductors. Some processes will be automated, but core value chain has structural resistance.
aiDisruption.opportunity_analysis: ON Semiconductor Corporation is positioned as a primary AI beneficiary. Semiconductors companies can leverage AI to expand TAM and create new revenue streams.
aiDisruption.net_assessment: ON Semiconductor Corporation faces a strong tailwind from AI. Opportunity significantly outweighs disruption risk.
